in_hebrew.name: Winni
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Winni הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word ἵνικος (hnikos), meaning 'helpful' or 'useful'. In the New Testament, the name Winni is not directly found, but it may be derived from the name Winifred, which is derived from the Welsh words gwen, meaning 'fair, white, blessed', and hawedd, meaning 'good, fair, gentle'.
